question: List partially covered Gram Panchayats in papum pare for Multi-purpose
retrieved_sql_examples: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%multi%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%ARUNACHAL PRADESH%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%PAPUM PARE%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) < COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: Show me coverage details for all blocks in belagavi for Multi-purpose
retrieved_sql_examples: SELECT sub.block_name, sub.total_villages, sub.covered_villages, ROUND((sub.covered_villages::numeric / sub.total_villages) * 100, 2) AS block_coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.block_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS covered_villages FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.block_code = dbgv.block_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%multi%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%KARNATAKA%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%BELAGAVI%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.block_name, dbgv.block_code) AS sub ORDER BY sub.block_name;
